note: 概念归属层：巴菲特体系里每个关键概念到底是谁的。防止把别人的智慧笼统归给巴菲特。证据全部来自 48 封股东信明文（2026-10-20 回源核验），引用均 ≤50 词。

evidence.quote: Confronted with a challenge to distill the secret of sound investment into three words, we venture the motto, Margin of Safety. Forty-two years after reading that, I still think those are the right three words.
evidence.note: 巴菲特在信中原文引用 Graham（前半句为 Graham 原话），并自述四十二年未变

evidence.quote: the margin of safety that Ben Graham identified as the cornerstone of intelligent investing
evidence.note: 明确把安全边际的发明权归给 Graham

attribution.agent_usage_rule: 引用安全边际时出处写 Graham（via Buffett letter:1990/1997），不写为巴菲特原创

evidence.quote: He said that you should imagine market quotations as coming from a remarkably accommodating fellow named Mr. Market who is your partner in a private business.
evidence.note: 1987 年信 Graham 致敬章节，巴菲特明确转述 Graham 的比喻

attribution.agent_usage_rule: 出处标 Graham（via Buffett letter:1987）；巴菲特的贡献是把一个课堂比喻用成了大众投资语言

attribution.concept: 以合理价格买伟大公司（对烟蒂法的否定）

evidence.quote: It's far better to buy a wonderful company at a fair price than a fair company at a wonderful price. Charlie understood this early; I was a slow learner.
evidence.note: 巴菲特亲口认领芒格的功劳

attribution.agent_usage_rule: 引用此判据时必须注明芒格推动；不得写成巴菲特顿悟

evidence.quote: Owner earnings ... represent reported earnings plus depreciation, depletion, amortization, and certain other non-cash charges less the average annual amount of capitalized expenditures for plant and equipment, etc. that the business requires.
What an investor needs is the ability to correctly evaluate selected businesses. Note that word selected: you don't have to be an expert on every company, or even many.

evidence.quote: our circle of competence has expanded only slowly over the years
